LanguageData.XPC_L3B_TotalMultiplierDescription: Controls the total XP required to progress from skill level 0 to 20.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B_DistributionDescription: Distributes the selected total XP across editable level ranges. These values are used by gameplay.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B_BoundariesApplyNotice: Stage boundaries can be edited below. Changes are applied only when you press Apply.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B_WeightsHelp: Weights split unlocked XP. Use L to lock a stage share; at least one stage stays unlocked.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B_VanillaDistributionActive: Vanilla distribution is active. Stored stage weights are currently ignored.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B_RoundingDescription: Rounds every individual level-up requirement. Exact keeps the calculated values unchanged.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B_RoundingFallback: Requested rounding: {0} | Effective: {1} because the current total XP is too small for the requested step.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B_LockTip: L: Lock/unlock this stage's target XP share. Unlocked stages divide the remaining XP by Weight.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B_LockedShareTip: Target {0}% | Applied {1}% (XP rounding may affect exact share)
